description: Add a component type to the project — a reusable block for components fields (hero, text, gallery…): a name and the sub-fields an item of it holds (the types a group's sub-fields take, a group or a relation; none sensitive, no components inside; a type may have no fields at all, a divider). A sub-field of type group holds a list of items of its own simple sub-fields (a pricing block's tiers, an FAQ block's questions): pass them in its `group.fields`. A sub-field of type relation links records of a collection the project has (a block of featured products): pass `relation` with the collection's key in `target` — a block holds a record id, or an array of them with cardinality many (list_records gives them), and Mapled checks them on every save; a collection of the site's signed-in users can't be linked. Its key is the lowercase, hyphenated name — items of a components field name it in `_type`; pass it in `components.allowed` of add_field. get_schema lists the project's types under componentTypes.

fields.description: The sub-fields of an item, in order; keys are the lowercase, hyphenated names.

group.description: For type group only: the sub-fields of each of its items (simple types, no group inside) and up to how many items it holds; a block holds it as a list of objects keyed by those sub-fields' keys.

relation.description: Required for type relation, not allowed otherwise. A block holds a record id, or an array of them for many.

cardinality.description: one (default): a block holds one linked record; many: a list of them (their order is kept).

onDelete.description: What a delete of a linked record does: restrict — the linked record can't be deleted while a block links to it; nullify — the links are cleared. Default: restrict when the sub-field is required, nullify otherwise.

target.description: Key of the collection its blocks link into (see get_schema) — not one of the site's signed-in users.

name: add_component_type
